title: Croatian Pudding with Silk
description: A creamy dessert that brings together the rich flavors of Croatia and silky texture.
instructions: 1. In a medium saucepan, combine the croatian pudding and silky milk.
2. Heat the mixture over medium heat, whisking constantly.
3. Add the juicy croatian cream and sugar, whisking until the sugar dissolves.
4. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes.
5. Remove from heat and let cool slightly.
6. Pour the mixture into individual serving cups or ramekins.
7. Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours, or until set.
8. Serve cold, garnished with a sprinkle of sugar if desired.
